summary: Iteration 2 delta verified: backend now emits per-key `migrations` (key, from, to, fromAngle, toAngle) inside REBALANCE and NODE_REMOVE log entries; frontend renders the new HitRateTimeline component and animates key migrations inside the HashRingViz when nodes are added/removed. Backend regression + new migration-payload tests pass 18/18. Frontend flows all exercised successfully with zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: HitRateTimeline's ResponsiveContainer briefly logs a recharts warning (width/height -1) during initial mount before the flex container resolves. Visual only, not a bug — could be silenced by giving the wrapper an explicit min-height during SSR/first paint, but not required.

Cluster.removeNode captures fromAngle once before ring.removeNode — correct. _nodeAnchorAngle returns the first matching virtual node on the ring; consistent with the anchor logic used by the front-end label placement.

page.jsx migrations dedup via `${ts}-${from}-${to}-${key}` could collide if multiple migrations of the same key hit the same edge within one ms. In practice this never happens because each REBALANCE/NODE_REMOVE carries each key once per event, so acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Used existing /api/reset fixture + TEST_ prefixed keys inside pytest. UI test used the existing Seed Sample Keys button.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 18 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_cache_simulator.py currently pass including 4 new tests: test_add_node_rebalance_log_contains_migrations_payload, test_empty_cluster_add_emits_no_migrations, test_remove_node_log_contains_migrations_with_from_angle_preserved, test_remove_empty_node_emits_no_migrations. To run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<public-url> pytest backend/tests/test_cache_simulator.py -v. Frontend smoke verified via Playwright against public URL: hit-rate-timeline testid renders with 0/25/50/75/100 Y-axis ticks, accumulates samples (multiple X-axis labels after ~4s of activity), ADD NODE produced 5 migration <g> groups during the ~900ms animation and cleared to 0 after 1.2s; REMOVE on a populated node produced 1 migration group. Zero console errors. Initial recharts width=-1 warning is benign (resolves on first frame).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All features working as specified.
